overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on multimodal dialogue response generation (both text and images) and uses comprehensive evaluation including automatic metrics and human assessment. Key findings: (1) The paper introduces a novel task of multimodal dialogue response generation; (2) Uses standard automatic metrics (F1, PPL, BLEU, ROUGE); (3) No LLM-as-judge evaluation; (4) Well-structured human evaluation with clear criteria.
